notablePrerequisites:
Sorin has at least three loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ezio.
Ezio does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sorin's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing an opponent's life total to become 10.
Deal combat damage to that opponent using Ezio.
Ezio triggers, causing you to pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to have that opponent lose the game.
